data.one_liner: Flutter widgets for chat bubbles, audio bubbles, image bubbles, date chips, and message bars.
data.what_it_does: Provides ready-to-use chat bubble widgets and input message bars similar to WhatsApp and iMessage. Supports text bubbles, audio/image attachments, link previews, reactions, and reply quotes.
use_when: You need to build a messaging or chat interface quickly in Flutter.
You want custom-shaped message bubbles with delivery receipts, timestamps, and swipe actions.
avoid_when: You are building a non-chat application that does not require message layout primitives.
strengths: Includes a wide variety of chat bubble designs, audio/image widgets, and message input bars.
Supports modern features like swipe gestures, link previews, and reactions out of the box.
Easy to implement with clean declarative code.
weaknesses: Focused entirely on individual UI elements rather than providing a complete out-of-the-box chat architecture or backend integration.
data.setup_notes: Simply add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import chat_bubbles.dart.
data.minimal_example:
BubbleSpecialThree(
  text: 'Please try and give some feedback on it!',
  color: Color(0xFF1B97F3),
  tail: true,
  textStyle: TextStyle(
    color: Colors.white,
    fontSize: 16
  ),
)
